title: Acids and bases: names and formulas

cards.front: What is the name of the substance with formula $H_2SO_4$? For HCl or a hydroxide, also name its aqueous solution.
What is the substance formula of sulfuric acid?
cards.back: $H_2SO_4$. The formula describes the composition of the substance, not every particle present in an aqueous solution.

cards.front: What is the name of the substance with formula $HNO_3$? For HCl or a hydroxide, also name its aqueous solution.
What is the substance formula of nitric acid?
cards.back: $HNO_3$. The formula describes the composition of the substance, not every particle present in an aqueous solution.

cards.front: What is the name of the substance with formula $HCl$? For HCl or a hydroxide, also name its aqueous solution.
cards.back: hydrogen chloride; its aqueous solution is called hydrochloric acid.

cards.front: What is the substance formula of the solute associated with hydrochloric acid?
cards.back: Hydrogen chloride: $HCl$. The formula describes the composition of the substance, not every particle present in an aqueous solution.

cards.front: What is the name of the substance with formula $NaOH$? For HCl or a hydroxide, also name its aqueous solution.
cards.back: sodium hydroxide; its aqueous solution is sodium hydroxide solution.

cards.front: What is the substance formula of the solute associated with aqueous sodium hydroxide solution?
cards.back: Sodium hydroxide: $NaOH$. The formula describes the composition of the substance, not every particle present in an aqueous solution.

cards.front: What is the name of the substance with formula $KOH$? For HCl or a hydroxide, also name its aqueous solution.

cards.front: What is the substance formula of the solute associated with aqueous potassium hydroxide solution?
cards.back: Potassium hydroxide: $KOH$. The formula describes the composition of the substance, not every particle present in an aqueous solution.

cards.front: What is the name of the substance with formula $Ca(OH)_2$? For HCl or a hydroxide, also name its aqueous solution.
cards.back: calcium hydroxide; its clear aqueous solution is called limewater.

cards.front: What is the substance formula of the solute associated with clear limewater?
cards.back: Calcium hydroxide: $Ca(OH)_2$. The formula describes the composition of the substance, not every particle present in an aqueous solution.

cards.front: What is the substance formula of the solute associated with baryta water?
